name: Coldseam The Burned Spire Judge's Exit Look
description: What a Spire judge wears when they're no longer one: a formal robe stripped of its insignia, rank piping removed with a blade — the ghost-lines of where it sat still visible in the fabric's sheen. Beneath it, a plain high-collar shirt in ash-white, buttoned to the throat. Trousers are Tier 4 cut but worn at the knees. Footwear still immaculate — the last pride. A Vanthorpe ankle monitor on the left leg, court-issue, blinking amber. Hair or head covering severe and unstyled. The whole look reads as someone who was Tier 5 this morning and is deciding what they are tonight.
functionality: Ankle monitor transmits location to GLMZ judicial authority at 30-second intervals; robe retains thermal regulation from original Spire manufacture; high collar conceals BCI port hardware from neural link used in judicial functions.
what_it_says: Power stripped to its skeleton — either a warning or a weapon, depending on what this person knows.
worn_by: characters in narrative transition from power to danger
story_hooks: The robe's insignia was removed by the judge themselves, before the tribunal finished — a statement that still hasn't been explained.
The ankle monitor has been broadcasting a second, encrypted signal no one at Vanthorpe authorized.
Three Tier 5 power brokers have made quiet contact since the sentencing — they want something only this person's judicial memory still holds.
